entry.en: To enter Canada, your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.
entry.es: Para entrar en Canadá, su pasaporte debe ser válido durante la duración de su estancia prevista.
entry.quote: To enter Canada, your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.

entry.en: Most people need either a visa or an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA), not both.
entry.es: La mayoría de las personas necesita un visado o una autorización electrónica de viaje (eTA), pero no ambos.
entry.quote: most people need a visa or an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) – not both.

entry.en: You do not need a visa for short visits, normally up to 6 months, though you may need an eTA instead.
entry.es: No necesita visado para visitas cortas, normalmente de hasta 6 meses, aunque puede que necesite una eTA.
entry.quote: You do not need a visa for short visits (normally up to 6 months). You may need an eTA instead.

entry.en: Canadian border officials may ask you to show a return or onward ticket and proof of sufficient funds.
entry.es: Los funcionarios fronterizos canadienses pueden pedirle un billete de vuelta o de continuación y prueba de fondos suficientes.
entry.quote: Canadian border officials may ask you to show a return or onward ticket and proof that you have sufficient funds to support yourself for the duration of your stay

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debe declarar cualquier cosa que pueda estar prohibida o sujeta a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: A child travelling alone or with only one parent or guardian should carry a letter of consent from the non-travelling parents or guardians.
entry.es: Un menor que viaje solo o con un solo progenitor o tutor debe llevar una carta de consentimiento de los demás progenitores o tutores.
entry.quote: If a child travels alone or with only one parent or legal guardian, they should carry a letter of consent from the non-travelling parents or guardians.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Canada.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Canadá.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Canada.

safety.en: Illegal drugs carry severe penalties, including a long jail sentence and heavy fines.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales conllevan penas severas, entre ellas largas condenas de cárcel y multas elevadas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs carry severe penalties. You should expect a long jail sentence and heavy fines

safety.en: It is illegal to take cannabis across the Canadian border without a permit or exemption authorised by Health Canada.
safety.es: Es ilegal cruzar la frontera canadiense con cannabis sin un permiso o exención autorizados por Health Canada.
safety.quote: It is illegal to take cannabis across the Canadian border without a permit or exemption authorised by Health Canada.

safety.en: In winter, highways are often closed because of snowstorms and avalanches in Alberta, British Columbia and other provinces.
safety.es: En invierno, las autopistas suelen cerrarse por tormentas de nieve y avalanchas en Alberta, Columbia Británica y otras provincias.
safety.quote: In winter, highways are often closed because of snowstorms and avalanches in Alberta, British Columbia and other provinces.

safety.en: Tornadoes can happen anywhere in Canada from May to September, with June to July the peak season in some regions.
safety.es: Los tornados pueden ocurrir en cualquier parte de Canadá de mayo a septiembre, con un máximo en junio y julio en algunas regiones.
safety.quote: Tornadoes can happen anywhere in Canada from May to September, but June to July is the peak season in:

safety.en: Wildfires can start at any time, with particular risk in western Canada and parts of Quebec, Ontario and Nova Scotia in summer.
safety.es: Los incendios forestales pueden empezar en cualquier momento, con riesgo especial en el oeste de Canadá y partes de Quebec, Ontario y Nueva Escocia en verano.
safety.quote: Wildfires can start at any time, whatever the season, although there is particular risk of fire in the grasslands and forests of western Canada, as well as in forested areas of Quebec, Ontario and Nova Scotia, during the summer months.

health.en: Dial 911 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Marque el 911 y pida una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 911 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Medical treatment can be very expensive and there are no special arrangements for British visitors.
health.es: El tratamiento médico puede ser muy caro y no hay acuerdos especiales para visitantes británicos.
health.quote: Medical treatment can be very expensive. There are no special arrangements for British visitors.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Canada, including Rockies destinations such as Banff and Lake Louise.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Canadá, incluidos destinos de las Rocosas como Banff y Lake Louise.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Canada, including skiing and hiking destinations in the Canadian Rockies such as Banff and Lake Louise.

health.en: Health care is not free for visitors, so it is important to be covered by insurance.
health.es: La atención sanitaria no es gratuita para los visitantes, por lo que es importante tener seguro.
health.quote: health care is not free for visitors; therefore it is important to make sure you are covered by your insurance when travelling to Canada.

health.en: Clean, safe drinking water is available from the tap in all cities and towns across Canada.
health.es: Hay agua potable limpia y segura del grifo en todas las ciudades y pueblos de Canadá.
health.quote: Clean, safe drinking water is available from the tap in all cities and towns across Canada.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police in Canada is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía en Canadá es el 911.

help.en: The coastguard number for maritime emergencies is 1 800 463 4393.
help.es: El número de la guardia costera para emergencias marítimas es 1 800 463 4393.

getting_in.en: Foreigners entering Canada visa-free by plane must get an eTA, which is not required when entering by land or sea.
getting_in.es: Los extranjeros que entran en Canadá sin visado por avión deben obtener una eTA, que no se exige al entrar por tierra o mar.
getting_in.quote: The eTA is not required if you are entering by land or sea.

getting_in.en: Canada no longer requires entry formalities for transferring between two international flights at Toronto Pearson Terminal 1, Vancouver or Montreal Dorval.
getting_in.es: Canadá ya no exige trámites de entrada para hacer transbordo entre dos vuelos internacionales en Toronto Pearson Terminal 1, Vancouver o Montreal Dorval.
getting_in.quote: Canada no longer requires entry formalities for transferring between two international flights at Toronto Pearson Terminal 1, Vancouver or Montreal Dorval

getting_around.en: The best way to get around the country is by air, and Air Canada has by far the largest network.
getting_around.es: La mejor forma de moverse por el país es en avión, y Air Canada tiene con diferencia la red más grande.
getting_around.quote: The best way to get around the country is by air. Flag carrier Air Canada has by far the largest network and most frequent schedules.

getting_around.en: Travelling to or around northern Canada often requires flying.
getting_around.es: Viajar al norte de Canadá o moverse por él a menudo requiere volar.
getting_around.quote: getting around in Canada is almost completely restricted to the southern "Canadian corridor", and travelling to or getting around northern Canada often requires flying.

getting_around.en: Canada is very car-dependent, and many visitors rent a car.
getting_around.es: Canadá depende mucho del coche y muchos visitantes alquilan uno.
getting_around.quote: Canada is a very car-dependent country, and many visitors rent a car.

getting_around.en: Foreign visitors can generally drive on their foreign licence for up to 90 days if it is in English or French.
getting_around.es: Los visitantes extranjeros pueden conducir generalmente con su licencia extranjera hasta 90 días si está en inglés o francés.
getting_around.quote: foreign visitors are allowed to drive using their foreign licence for up to 90 days if their licence is in English or French

getting_around.en: There are no high-speed trains in Canada, and passenger rail is often expensive, slow and inconvenient.
getting_around.es: En Canadá no hay trenes de alta velocidad y el ferrocarril de pasajeros suele ser caro, lento e incómodo.
getting_around.quote: Passenger rail service in Canada is often an expensive, slow and inconvenient alternative to other types of transport. There are no high-speed trains in Canada

money.en: Canada's currency is the Canadian dollar (CAD).
money.es: La moneda de Canadá es el dólar canadiense (CAD).
money.quote: Canada's currency is the Canadian dollar (symbol: $, ISO currency code: CAD)

money.en: Restaurant wait staff in Canada typically receive 15–18% on the before-tax total.
money.es: El personal de sala de los restaurantes en Canadá suele recibir entre el 15 y el 18 % del total antes de impuestos.
money.quote: Restaurant wait staff in Canada typically receive 15–18% on the before-tax total.

money.en: Bargaining is extremely rare in ordinary retail shopping in Canada.
money.es: Regatear es extremadamente raro en las compras minoristas habituales en Canadá.
money.quote: Bargaining is extremely rare in ordinary retail shopping in Canada

money.en: Tipping is not appropriate in cafeterias, fast food establishments and takeaway stands.
money.es: No es apropiado dar propina en cafeterías, establecimientos de comida rápida ni puestos de comida para llevar.
money.quote: Tipping is not appropriate in cafeterias, fast food establishments and takeaway stands.

etiquette.en: When entering a private home, it is usually expected that you take off your shoes unless the host says otherwise.
etiquette.es: Al entrar en una casa particular, normalmente se espera que uno se quite los zapatos, salvo que el anfitrión diga lo contrario.
etiquette.quote: When entering a private home, it is usually expected that you take off your shoes unless the host specifically tells you not to.

etiquette.en: Canada is widely regarded as a very polite society where apologizing, excusing and thanking is very common.
etiquette.es: Canadá es considerada una sociedad muy educada, donde es muy habitual pedir disculpas, pedir perdón y dar las gracias.
etiquette.quote: Canada is widely regarded as a very polite society, where apologizing, excusing and thanking is very common

etiquette.en: Most Canadians treat open displays of racism, sexism or homophobia with pointed scorn.
etiquette.es: La mayoría de los canadienses reacciona con marcado desprecio ante muestras abiertas de racismo, sexismo u homofobia.
etiquette.quote: Most Canadians will treat open displays of racism, sexism, or homophobia with rather pointed scorn.

etiquette.en: Quebec's relationship with the rest of the country may be a sensitive topic.
etiquette.es: La relación de Quebec con el resto del país puede ser un tema delicado.
etiquette.quote: Quebec's somewhat strained relationship with the rest of the country — the result of a still-somewhat active secession movement — may be a sensitive topic.

connectivity.en: Anyone may get a Canadian prepaid mobile number by providing a name and a physical address in Canada.
connectivity.es: Cualquiera puede obtener un número móvil prepago canadiense dando un nombre y una dirección física en Canadá.
connectivity.quote: All you need is to provide your name and a physical address in Canada.

connectivity.en: Coverage is good in cities and on busy transportation corridors but non-existent in many remote areas.
connectivity.es: La cobertura es buena en las ciudades y en corredores de transporte concurridos, pero inexistente en muchas zonas remotas.
connectivity.quote: Coverage is good in cities and on busy transportation corridors, but non-existent in many remote areas.

connectivity.en: Because carriers are shutting down 3G networks, it is best to bring a 4G/LTE capable device.
connectivity.es: Como los operadores están cerrando sus redes 3G, lo mejor es llevar un dispositivo compatible con 4G/LTE.
connectivity.quote: it's best to bring a 4G/LTE capable device.
